# Local HTML Tools
# https://localhtmltools.lachlanallison.com

> Curated directory of browser-first, offline-friendly HTML utilities. Tools run locally in the browser with limited or no network dependence. Searchable, filterable, open source — submissions via pull request.

## Main pages
- /
- /contributing.html
- /badge/

## Tool directory
- 70+ curated tools with detail pages at /tool/{slug}/
- Examples: /tool/chrome-session-viewer/, /tool/browser-extensions-icons/, /tool/map-a-route/, /tool/video-toolkit/
- Full list and metadata in https://github.com/lachlanallison/local-html-tools/blob/main/data/tools.json
